study type: Mixed-method study (secondary analysis of repeated cross-sectional survey data and qualitative interviews/focus group discussions)
cohort: The quantitative analysis included newborns of women identified from Ghana Demographic and Health Survey data sets (2008 and 2014) who either utilized or did not utilize Ghana's 'free' maternal health care policy.
finding: Newborns in the 'free' maternal health care policy group had a significantly higher likelihood of stillbirth (aOR: 1.64) and perinatal death (aOR: 2.04) compared to those in the no 'free' maternal health care policy group, despite an overall decline in perinatal mortality.
